$comment: The SIMAI language registry (localization standard §3, decision L4: kept in the Framework, products read it with the Framework). order is the switcher order, priority the translation order (null: ru is the language of writing). The registry declares that a language exists; a product publishes it (§4). Arabic ar added 11th by owner decision C278 (2026-11-17); languages of CIS countries other than Russian are not in the registry. pack: how the Framework's interface words reach a page in that language - built-in (English, inside every bundle) or shipped (a language file core/lang/<code>.js and its parts core/lang/<code>/<family>.json, listed in core/lang/index.json, owner decisions C282 and C278). The pack's code is the locale in lower case (pt-br, zh-hans). aliases: the page languages that take this language's pack, matched without regard to case (lang="zh-CN" or "zh" speaks zh-hans, lang="pt" speaks pt-br); a page language with a region the registry does not name takes its base language's (zh-TW -> zh -> zh-hans, pt-PT -> pt -> pt-br). Written into core/lang/index.json by scripts/build-language-packs.mjs.
